posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
I was following the System Commands playlist on YouTube to cover certain topics before the course content is released. I had covered till “Pattern Matching” hoping that things like Shell Variables, Software Management, and Pattern Matching would be a part of Week 2 or Week 3.

But the Week 2 course contents that were released cover “Command Line Editors” instead and have skipped over the aforementioned topics. I believe they would be covered in the future weeks, but because of the order of lectures in the playlist not matching the course content order I ended up studying something irrelevant (in respect of Week 2).

I believe it could be beneficial for everyone if the lectures in the YouTube playlist were ordered similar to the course content, so anyone wanting to learn about the things beforehand would be able to do so.

System Commands Resources - Google Sheets

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Thanks for bringing this to our attention, we are sorry you had to go through this experience from support. We have informed the team to re-order the original playlist.

However, till then, we have updated the course playlist link to another one, which is in-order, and marks each week clearly.

Please use this link instead: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLuZiiAWg2wqf0TXCVYWJW8dtdt2bFao1.
